What these actually are: 'C1' is a branch label; the object is the rank-2 q-difference module of [m+2]_q b_{m+2} = b_{m+1} + b_m; pipeline/graph bookkeeping vocabulary ('wired', 'orphan block', 'section lead'), not reader-facing.
